title: Show role and profile in attach status bar
description: Add a role/profile section between working directory and token/cost in the attach bottom status bar, formatted as '<role> [<profile>]'. Preserve visual ordering while changing narrow-screen retention priority to: working directory, role/profile, agent status, mode, then all remaining sections. Add width-boundary regression coverage.

comments.author: fond-frost
comments.text: Implemented and self-reviewed: the status bar now renders '<role> [<profile>]' between working directory and token/cost; the callback reads RuntimeConfig dynamically so rotations update attached clients. Narrow-screen drop order is tokens, help, agent name, mode, status, role/profile, with working directory truncated only as the final fallback. Added exact boundary, full width-sweep, empty-section, and runtime wiring tests. go test ./internal/session/client ./internal/session and make check pass.
